source.ar: التوزيع السنوي وتوزيع حصص المقاطع (Annual allotment & Sequence repartition) — منشور للعموم؛ الأسابيع تقديرية (حصتان أسبوعيًا)
source.fr: Annual allotment & sequence repartition (partagé publiquement) ; semaines estimées (2 séances/semaine)

objectives: Name/identify common jobs and occupations.
Ask and answer questions about family members and friends' jobs and occupations.
Name/identify common places of work.
Lexis: Jobs with -er, -or, -ist, -ian (farmer, teacher, doctor, dentist, musician); places of work (school, hospital, farm, office, post office)
Grammar: Present simple: to do, to be, to work; What's her/his job?; Is s/he a doctor?; a, an; in, at
Phonics: Intonation in simple sentences and wh-questions; sounds /ʒ/ vs /dʒ/
